tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every surface.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Surfaces: top bar, section cards, chart sheet.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Chart numbers, bar lines and main text. The only color that should pull the eye. 15.9:1 on paper (light), 13.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, captions, next-section preview, labels. 5.8:1 on paper (light), 6.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: primary button, current section chip.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines only. Below 3:1, so never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, chips and inputs. 3.4:1 on paper in both themes (WCAG non-text contrast).

tokens.name: md
tokens.usage: Red pencil: the MD label, instrument tags and MD cues. Never for errors or decoration. 5.8:1 on paper (light), 6.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: dynamic
tokens.usage: Blue pencil: dynamics (p, mf, cresc.), links. 7.5:1 on paper (light), 7.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px with 2px offset.

styles.name: chord-xl
styles.usage: Chords in the current section, atril mode on iPad.

styles.name: chord-md
styles.usage: Chords in editor preview and on desktop.

styles.name: song-title
styles.usage: Song title at the top of a chart.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Open it up a little. Don't go all out yet.
styles.usage: MD notes and body text; readable from a music stand.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, set name, emphasized UI text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Key, meter, tempo, chips, bar counts.

styles.name: dynamic-mark
styles.usage: Dynamics inside a bar, in the dynamic color.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small secondary lines. Never smaller on iPad.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a chip or tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips; gap between a section title and its count.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between top-bar items; padding of buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section card padding; gap between page blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top-bar side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page side padding on iPad and desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Bars and bar lines: always square, like a printed chart.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, instrument tags, section cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: bar-line
tokens.usage: Bar lines in the current section, in ink.

tokens.name: bar-line-light
tokens.usage: Bar lines in previews and the next-section strip.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Card outlines and dividers, in rule.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything you can tap on iPad.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of a bar in atril mode.

tokens.name: bar-height-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a bar in the next-section preview.
